item.title: WELSH HEAVYWEIGHTS SCRATCH ONE GRUB DETAIL NEW SINGLE & DEBUT ALBUM
item.description: WELSH HEAVYWEIGHTS SCRATCH ONE GRUB DETAIL NEW SINGLE & DEBUT ALBUM Welsh heavyweights SCRATCH ONE GRUB rise from the valleys with their blistering debut album, One, out Friday 27th February. Dispatching burly riffs, progressive know-how, alt-metal grit, and fiery passion, the emerging six-piece are primed to break into the UK metal scene. Their new single, Ysbryd, is out now, and is in perfect alignment with their manifesto. Check out the video here – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nx1pgW8O3u4
